title: Chapter 278 Fighting For Luck
content:
Chapter 278 Fighting For Luck

Meng Shanhan's figure not far from Lu Xue saw that Lu Xue had nothing to do, then pinched her hands, and countless black ice blades condensed from all around.

call out!

Lu Xue didn't move at all, and still allowed the countless black ice blades to penetrate into her body.

After repeated this several times, Lu Xue was unharmed, but her breath became stronger and stronger.

"It's already invincible."

Standing there, Lu Xue murmured to herself, then looked at Meng Shanhan in the distance.

Unfortunately, it is not the original body, but can only use Mon Shanhan's attack and his combat skills. Now, when all Mon Shanhan's attacks are invalid, Mon Shanhan has no choice.

If Monsanthan's original body is here, there may be a glimmer of hope.

Lu Xue shook her head slightly and stopped thinking about it.

A powerful force slowly condensed from his hands.

“It’s time to end.”

Buzz —

The space was vibrating, and a biting chill continued to emanate from Lu Xue's body.

I don’t know how much more terrifying than Meng Shanhan’s attack.

The next moment.

There was a loud bang.

A huge ice gun condensed out and penetrated Meng Shanhan in the distance, and then flew away to the distance with Meng Shanhan.

After a moment.

The space trembled again, and a portal appeared in front of Lu Xue.

Next, it will be a stronger opponent.

This time Lu Xue gained a physical advantage, and she won so smoothly.

But the opponent will not be so simple and easy to deal with.

Lu Xue stepped in and disappeared from the spot.

Meanwhile, in the square.

Everyone also immediately saw Lu Xue's ranking rise again.

"Senior Brother Meng actually lost so quickly?!"

A man suddenly spoke out in surprise.

Although it has been a long time since Monsanhan's last ranking, Monsanhan's strength in the martial arts tower is not as strong as himself.

But it shouldn't be so weak either.

Then there is only one possibility, Lu Xue is much stronger than Meng Shanhan.

Thinking of this, everyone's breathing was a little rapid.

"My academy is really full of talents."

In this way, everyone watched in the square for several days.

Some students who were rated in the martial arts tower went in and out, but Lu Xue was not there.

One day.

Outside Tiandi Academy became lively again.

An old man in a yellow robe brought a teenager outside the academy.

"Master, is this the so-called Tiandi Academy?"

The boy looked at the Tiandi Academy in front of him with a hint of disdain in his eyes.

Hearing this, the old man beside him said indifferently: "Disciple, the fairy world is very big. Don't be proud and complacent if you have a little ability. Think back then,,,"

Before the old man finished speaking, the young man nodded and said, "Master, stop talking, my disciple knows."

He had heard this many times, and his ears were calloused.

But he went down the mountain countless times and found many famous geniuses to challenge him, but without exception, he never lost.

He was disappointed.

Since then, he has rarely gone down the mountain.

Now, with the arrival of the prosperous age, according to Master’s words, there will be many powerful geniuses in the fairy world.

So, he went down the mountain again.

And he followed the master down the mountain.

Just as the boy cleared his throat and was about to shout, the boy suddenly noticed the boy sitting there wiping his knife in the corner of the door of Tiandi Academy.

"Um?"

At this time, the old man in the yellow robe also looked at the young man who used the knife.

Suddenly, the old man frowned.

"Broken knife?"

"What are you looking at? I haven't seen a knife before!"

Facing the gazes of the master and apprentice, Dao Qing did not spoil it and directly quarreled.

Seeing that Daoqing had such a bad attitude, the young man frowned and said, "You academy guardian is so unqualified?"

Although he is a little proud, he is still a person of some quality.

What's wrong with the door watching in front of me?

Hearing the boy's words, Dao Qing stood up directly.

"If you don't accept it, just get out of here, so it's embarrassing to get in."

Dao Qing looked at the boy in the distance and said straight.

He still doesn’t know what the other party’s purpose is to come to the academy?

If you really can't even beat yourself, then you'd better get out as soon as possible to save your energy.

"you!"

At this moment, the young man's veins bulged and he stared at Dao Qing in the distance.

"Master, your disciple wants to beat him, beat him down!"

The boy turned his head and looked at the old man in yellow robe and said.

The old man in the yellow robe did not object to this and nodded slightly, "Go ahead, be careful."

As soon as he finished speaking, the boy disappeared directly.

Bang!

A metal collision sounded.

I saw that the young man appeared directly in front of Dao Qing.

At this moment, Dao Qing placed the broken knife in his hand in front of him, just blocking the boy's attack.

"Haha, I really underestimate you."

call out!

The boy instantly opened a distance from Dao Qing, looking at Dao Qing from a distance, and smirked.

He wanted to do something unexpected, and he immediately rushed to the scene.

He was a little surprised that Dao Qing could react and take on his attack.

But there is no big problem.

At this moment, Dao Qing looked a little solemn.

The opponent's strength is not very strong, and it is far inferior to him, but the opponent's speed is terrifying.

Until now, I can only vaguely capture the other person's figure.

If I reacted a little slower than that blow just now, I would have lost.

It seems that I should also face the same-level figures in the fairy world.

Buzz —

Suddenly, a knife intention slowly overflowed from the sword raising body and then continued to inject into the broken knife in his hand.

In an instant, the broken knife gradually became complete, which was formed by the gathering of the knife's intent.

"Come again!"

laugh!

The knife rushes with the knife, and the knife whirls!

......

At this moment, the heroes of the fairy world are rising together and look glorious.

Every genius and powerful man shows his power in this prosperous era, intending to become the most shining light of this era.

However, people do not know that all this is because of the protection of an existence.

The vanity zone.

In front of the huge abyss, two figures sat cross-legged here, and nothing around could get close to them.

Including time.

For Lu Daosheng at this moment, 300,000 years are just a waste of time.

But at this time, Lu Daosheng slowly opened his eyes.

Buzz —

A subtle voice came from the other side of the abyss again.

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly, then stepped forward.

Suddenly, terrifying pressure came from the abyss, wanting to pull Lu Daosheng into the abyss directly, and then tear it apart.

But Lu Daosheng was expressionless and allowed the pressure to pour down, but he was still indifferent.

In this way, Lu Daosheng directly crossed the abyss and came to the other side of the abyss.

A vague figure appeared not far in front of Lu Daosheng.

"I was surprised that you could come over."

The phantom looked at Lu Daosheng and said slowly.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked cold and said in a low voice: "If you call me for nothing, believe it or not, I will erase you!"

Buzz —

A powerful aura rose from Lu Daosheng's body.

The phantom suddenly became illusory.

At this moment, the Phantom was shocked.

There is such a strong man on the other side of the abyss. From the beginning to now, this is the first time he has faced the other side of the abyss.

It’s a pity that he is not the original body and cannot clearly feel which one is stronger or weaker than the other.

I think that's definitely not as good as him.

After all, the environment is limited.

It is impossible for an existence stronger than him to appear there.

Thinking of this, the phantom calmed down again.

"You are strong, but not enough, you don't know how big the world is."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng took a deep breath.

If the other party still says such nonsense in the next sentence, he will do it directly.

If it weren't for the sake of my daughter, there would be you who are now.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was not speaking in front of him, the phantom paused and then said, "I call you, so there is a serious matter."

He called Lu Daosheng here and had two ideas.

First, it is to test Lu Daosheng's strength.

If Lu Daosheng didn't come here, or could not come here, then nothing would be done.

When the time is right, he will do it himself and everything will be settled.

2. If Lu Daosheng really comes over, he can temporarily face the other party.

Of course, it's only temporary.

For some reason, he can't take action now.

And the other party is able to come over, which is considered to be a bit powerful.

So you can talk to the other party about the conditions.

After pondering for a moment, the phantom continued, "I know that on the other side now, we are working hard to improve our strength."

"You know that you are not our opponents at all now. What I am right?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was a little silent.

Right, not right.

If you include yourself in the fairy world and the deserted city, then you will be nothing.

But if you don't count yourself,

“Continue.”

Lu Daosheng spoke indifferently.

Hearing this, the phantom nodded and continued, "There are also some young and strong little guys on my side."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows slightly.

He had guessed what the other party meant.

"Your abacus is really loud, I heard it on the other end."

The sound came from the abyss.

Lu Daosheng and the phantom looked at the same time, and saw a figure slowly emerging from the abyss.

The next moment, a beautiful figure appeared here.

Yan Lingyun.

"Lingyun, why are you here?"

Seeing Yan Lingyun, Lu Daosheng immediately showed a smile.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun stared at the phantom not far away and said coldly: "This guy has bad intentions."

Looking at Yan Lingyun, he was a little angry.

Lu Daosheng's heart skipped a beat.

Lingyun seems to attach great importance to the fairy world.

That's right. Lingyun spent some time in the fairy world and even accepted an apprentice.

In this case, I seem to be a little better to the fairy world in secret.

In Lu Daosheng's eyes.

Only his own people are worthy of his protection.

As for any world, except for Hongmeng at the beginning, I have never protected a certain world.

There is always the only great country in his heart.

Retracting his thoughts, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's nothing wrong. With me here, how can you suffer a loss."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng looked at the phantom in the distance.

"You do this, you don't want to do it in vain. What are the benefits of this? Do you still want me to tell me?"

Hearing this, the phantom was a little silent.

He really wanted to do it in vain at the beginning.

But now, it seems not very good.

It's really a bit unrealistic to do it in vain.

"What do you want?"

asked the phantom.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng showed a smile.

"You want your descendants to come to the fairy world to absorb the luck of the fairy world. Then that's the best. Give us a little luck. In this way, I'll let your descendants come."

As soon as these words came out, a breath suddenly overflowed from the phantom's body.

"You dream!"

The phantom's expression was a bit ferocious at this moment.

He never expected that the man in front of him would have such a big appetite.

I want their luck.

It's a dream.

However, he didn't know that Lu Daosheng was not asking him, but notifying him.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly took action.

His arms immediately extended infinitely and flew straight into the depths of the void in the distance.

At the same time, an illusory aura was constantly sucked into Lu Daosheng's palm.

Seeing this scene, the phantom's eyes were about to break.

"You are presumptuous!"

The phantom took action decisively.

boom!

A roar sounded.

Lu Daosheng remained motionless, while Yan Lingyun stood in front of Lu Daosheng and looked at the shadow in the distance sarcastically.

At this time, Lu Daosheng stretched his arm back and smiled and said, "The transaction was successful."

"What!"

At this moment, the phantom felt the passing of some power in his body.

The guy in front of me really has the ability to seize their luck.

Damn it, damn it!
